failure_policy: Evaluation requires afterok of the exact parent and a completed/exact10M manifest/checkpoint. Invalid dependencies are cancelled; one afterany collector reports failure. No automatic retraining, resume, or substitute checkpoint.
interpretation_limits: All episode seeds and training seeds are development-only; held-out/final-test blocks remain unused.
Episode mean, populationSD, quantiles and tail counts describe each fixed policy; they do not measure training-seed uncertainty.
1000 and zero return cutoffs are descriptive, not paper thresholds.
Historical simulator compatibility remains unverified exact paper binary parity.

final_status_collector.role: Read final scheduler/result evidence only; no simulator, training, retry or resume.
